name: Jaisalmer–Rewari Highway
aka: Formed largely from parts of the old NH 15 and old NH 11
history: NH 11 crosses Rajasthan from the Thar Desert near Jaisalmer to Rewari in Haryana. On the way it links the desert cities of Jaisalmer and Bikaner with the Shekhawati region, whose towns such as Fatehpur, Mandawa and Jhunjhunu are famous for beautifully painted old mansions called havelis. The highway was pieced together after the 2010 renumbering, mostly from parts of the old NH 15 and the old NH 11.
facts: At about 848 km, it is one of the longest highways lying almost entirely in Rajasthan.
Connects two famous desert tourist cities, Jaisalmer and Bikaner.
Passes through the Shekhawati towns of Fatehpur, Mandawa and Jhunjhunu, known for their painted havelis.
Its western end near Myajlar is deep in the Thar Desert, close to the India–Pakistan border.
